verdict.rationale: LiveKit describes itself as an open-source platform, its docs refer to starting on open source and self-hosting, and the server is published as a public GitHub repository (livekit/livekit) whose source users can read. Community users confirm running it themselves and building on the open Pion ion-sfu. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named (e.g. Apache 2.0), and there is no evidence about which components (Cloud-only features, agents framework, SDKs) are open versus proprietary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: LiveKit is an open-source platform for building voice, video, and physical AI agents.
You can start on open source and migrate to LiveKit Cloud without rewriting application code.
Easy to deploy: single binary, Docker or Kubernetes
Appreciated that LiveKit keeps a separate Protocol project (protobuf messages). It gives a quick sense of what's under the hood and serves as a helpful reference.
